source.itemName: Premier envol — ancien récit Mission Toba
source.permissionContext: Existing owner France campaign media authorization; creator source credited, no open license or named photographer inferred.
source.qualification: Real photograph of spectator and projection screen; projected fictional landscape is explicitly described as screen content. Original02 individually viewed, no crop or editing. Image05 rejected as a composite with illustrative entrance rendering; no extraction. Venue identity linked by creator current official Premier envol URL and 2015 report.

metadata.description: La projection de Mission Toba dans la salle devenue ensuite Premier envol à Vulcania.

altTexts.value: Un spectateur face à un écran panoramique montrant un paysage volcanique lumineux dans Mission Toba.
A spectator faces a panoramic screen showing a brightly lit volcanic landscape inside Mission Toba.
Ein Zuschauer blickt in Mission Toba auf eine Panoramaleinwand mit einer hell erleuchteten Vulkanlandschaft.
Een toeschouwer kijkt in Mission Toba naar een panoramisch scherm met een helder verlicht vulkaanlandschap.
Uno spettatore osserva uno schermo panoramico con un luminoso paesaggio vulcanico all’interno di Mission Toba.
Un espectador mira una pantalla panorámica con un luminoso paisaje volcánico dentro de Mission Toba.
Widz patrzy na panoramiczny ekran z rozświetlonym krajobrazem wulkanicznym w Mission Toba.
Um espectador observa um ecrã panorâmico com uma paisagem vulcânica luminosa no interior de Mission Toba.
